title: [submission] TayDex - Base AMM prediction market with creator-authored rules
body:
### Link

https://taydex.fun

### What is it

Platform - somewhere users can trade event contracts.

### Which venues does it cover

TayDex on Base.

### What does it do, and why does it add something not already listed?

TayDex is a live Base-native USDC AMM where eligible adults in permitted jurisdictions can create source-defined binary event markets. It adds a different Base venue model: creator-authored rules, creator-entered results, a 24-hour objection window, and independent admin/oracle review when a result is challenged or not entered.

For the record, TayDex has 0 verified independent traders and $0 organic volume today; project/test liquidity and technical transactions are excluded. Public market feed: https://taydex.fun/api/markets. Geographic restrictions: https://taydex.fun/legal/restrictions. DefiLlama slug: `taydex`.

### Is this yours?

Yes. I am the founder and built TayDex.
